player_prompt.intro:
Mastermind i khelh meh a ni.
{code_length} digit a sei code i hmuh a ngai a, digit tin 1 atanga {num_numbers} thleng a ni, {repeats}.
I chhanna ah, '[2 1 4 5]' tih format hmangin i guess thehluh thei ang.
Guess tin hnu ah, black leh white pegs hmangin feedback i dawng ang.
Black peg chu digit dik, position dik a entir a, white peg chu digit dik, position dik lo a entir.
{max_turns} vawi i nei a, code i guess theih nan.

invalid_move.wrong_format: A lehlam chu a hmun hranin, inṭhungkaw hrûnga dah i ni lo.
invalid_move.not_integers: Entry zawng zawngte chu integer dik tak a ni tur a ni.
invalid_move.wrong_length: A chhutnaah hian {code_length} chiah a awm tûr a ni.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Number zawng zawngte chu 1 leh {num_numbers} inkâra a ni tûr.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: Number duplicate chu phal a ni lo.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: I lo chhut tawh {guess} a. A dang han sawi chhin teh le.

game_action.feedback: [{guess}] i theh lut. Feedback: {black_pegs} black peg(s), {white_pegs} white peg(s).

outcome.win: Code chu ai la crack ta, {black_pegs} aṭangin {code_length} pegs te chu dik taka
outcome.turn_limit: Turn limit i tawh. I ti dik {percent} percent number te
